NVIDIA DLSS SDK 310.9.16
------------------------
This software contains source code provided by NVIDIA Corporation.

bin\upscaler_bridge.dll has NVIDIA's static library nvsdk_ngx_s.lib built in,
in object form, with the inline helpers of the SDK's headers. It exists to be
built into an application with functions of its own, such as a game host. Do
not hand the dll out on its own and do not offer it as a product of its own:
the SDK's terms (sections 1c, 2a and 4b) allow it only inside an application.
Copies stay under terms at least as protective as NVIDIA's (section 2c).
Text: third_party\licenses\NVIDIA_RTX_SDK_LICENSE.txt

NOT in this package: nvngx_dlss.dll, the SDK's headers and its library. Get
them from NVIDIA, under NVIDIA's licence: https://github.com/NVIDIA/DLSS
Use the release file from lib\Windows_x86_64\rel, never the dev one, and do not
change it: NGX refuses a file whose NVIDIA signature is gone.
An application that ships nvngx_dlss.dll must also show the third party notices
of section 9.5 of the DLSS Programming Guide (section 4.2.3 of the guide).

NVIDIA, DLSS and RTX are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation. This project is not
sponsored or endorsed by NVIDIA.
